craft_notes: Sthāyin: turn-joy (Devī→Bhairava). Rupture: dash after fullness. Close: Unsurpassed. Rejected: one voice — killed: two speakers kept; 'unsurpassable answer' flat — kept sung form.

lines: Tell me of her, god of gods, by whom I come to fullness. —
Hear, blessed Lady: beyond all answering, the Unsurpassed.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tām me kathaya deveśa yena tṛptiṃ vrajāmy aham | śṛṇu devi mahābhage uttarasyāpy anuttaram

reads_against.argmap: Devī asks fullness; Bhairava answers: hear — even of the answer, the unsurpassable.
c1_essence: Fullness asked; answer beyond answers promised.
